versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for retrieving public content data from Xiaohongshu (小红书).
- Supports keyword-based note search, note detail retrieval, comment extraction, and public creator post monitoring, all via command-line scripts.
- Provides structured JSON output for use in content research, trend analysis, KOL screening, and marketing reporting.
- Environment variable GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN required for API access.
- Includes thorough error handling, input validation, and self-healing best practices to ensure robust data collection and easy troubleshooting.
